key_idea: Scan authors in order and always pick the lexicographically smallest part that is >= the previously chosen part; a smaller choice never hurts later authors.
sketch: Exchange argument: keeping the last chosen key as small as possible leaves the most options for the rest. For each author take the minimum name part not less than the previous pick; if none exists print impossible. O(total characters). Plain std::string comparison is correct since every part is Capital+lowercase. Any valid answer is accepted, so sample 2 printed a different but valid selection (Douglas Levi Potter Sam), which I verified by hand as non-descending; samples 1 and 3 matched exactly.
